doc_friction.issue: `targets --probe 20` with no --under probes nothing useful for a specific file; aiming at recently changed files (league-schedule-generator, shift-roster-builder, changepoint-detector) found every guarded file >20s, costing several probe minutes before landing on hvac-load-calc.
The pkill bracket hint is right, but the hook also rejects a command line where the unbracketed pattern appears elsewhere (e.g. the server start in the same call); worth saying 'in its own call'.

deviations.why: Step 4b asks for a class guard; the defects were one-off logic faults in one venture (a hard-coded size in messages, a missing warning branch, one plain-object lookup), with no cheap repo-wide lint that would not be noisy.
deviations.did: Guarded each with a test in the venture suite that ventures-tests.yml runs on every PR; no new platform/ci lint.
deviations.result: All three defects and six gaps fail CI if reintroduced.

real_defects.issue: A trunk too big for every size warned 'needs more than a 40 in. round' and the report/page said 'over 40 in.' even when the user's size list went to 60 in. (the code had tried 60). Now names the largest size tried (settings.trunkLargestIn).
With two or more returns, a return trunk too big for every size was set to null with no warning, so the report and page silently showed no return trunk. Now listed with diameterIn null and a warning.

designFromLoad read ducts.lengths[room] off a plain object, so a room named toString or constructor got a function as its length and the design was refused even with a default length. Now Object.hasOwn.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior engineer: mutation triage, 9 tests, 3 fixes, post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
